From HOW to WHY

Starting with a question, we can discover the path to entirely new possibilities

OUR VISION

We’ve spent decades learning
how to create and evolve.

But today, knowing how is no longer enough.


Asking 'HOW' helps us decide what to do next.

But asking 'WHY' gives purpose to what we do.


As the world faces overwhelming information,

asking 'WHY' becomes crucial.

It is a mindful search for meaning and an act of courage in an age defined by speed.

OUR PURPOSE
WHY = PURPOSE

To restore our sense of inquiry,

To rediscover meaning,

To place humanity back at the center,

To reconnect a fragmented world.


To rediscover our purpose,

we return to asking WHY.

2025:Forum Theme
MINDSET:
Thinking with Purpose

This year, our theme is MINDSET—

the lens through which 

we see, think, and decide.

We believe that every meaningful action begins by asking why, and 

that how we choose to think shapes what we ultimately create.

The Global Mindset

Experience:

Engage with the world firsthand


Adaptability:

Embrace diversity with responsibility


Perspective:

Understand systems, shift perspectives


Integration:

Act with whole-self alignment

The Design Mindset

Empathy:

Understanding people


Openness:

Welcoming ambiguity


Experimentation:

Trying ideas


Collaboration:

Co-creating with others

WHY:2025 brings together

creative leaders
from diverse fields.

The Global Mindset
Part 1: Rethinking the Global Panel Conversation 


In the first session, global leaders share their perspectives on 

leadership, cultural fluency, and systems thinking—offering insight into 

how we navigate an increasingly interconnected world.

EUN MEE, KIM

UN Women National Ambassador

President, Ewha Womans University

Scholar-diplomat advancing inclusive development and leadership in higher education.

JENNY MING

Rothy’s CEO

Founding President, Old Navy

Iconic retail leader now coaching global executives in purpose-driven leadership and brand growth.

SØREN VESTER HALDRUP

UNDP Global Policy Centre for Governance

Financial Integrity & Systems Innovation Specialist

Applies systems thinking and design-led approaches
to address transnational corruption and financial
crime across public sector ecosystems.

The Design Mindset
Part 2: Creating with Purpose Panel Conversation 


The afternoon session features creative leaders who apply

empathy, innovation, and human-centered design to reimagine systems,

solve complex challenges, and shape purposeful futures. 

SANG-YUP, LEE

Vice President, Hyundai Motor Group

Head of Hyundai Global Design Center (HMG)

Play a leading role in strengthening the global competitiveness of Genesis design.

ENRIQUE MARTINEZ GONZÁLEZ

Leadership in design and innovation, FRSA

Senior Advisor, U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM)

Drives human-centered policy and civic-service innovation.
Design lecturer in Executive Education programs at Harvard Law School.
Full-time faculty member with OPM’s Federal Executive Institute (FEI)

NAH KEN

Board Member, World Design Organization

World Design Organization (WDO) Board of Directors

Red Dot Design Award Jury Member

Chairman, Design & Brand Committee of the Korea Consulting Association (KCA)

Professor, Hongik IDAS (Design Management)
